thesis: The speakers argue that the value of AI models lies not in their general capability but in their specific utility for editable design and marketing workflows, such as controlling typography, layout, and text accuracy. They explain that Ideogram released an open-weight model to extend its reach to inference providers and enterprises, allowing them to customize the model for professional creative processes while maintaining a focus on building the foundation model itself.
